notes.title: Version 1.5 Update
notes.content:
There is now a new look in battle! Environments are more textured, and terrain objects now have a light outline.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41195338/1f685735bc45c21a17f246209a88f0fe315734fe.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41195338/4310351cccc5a97d6043e4d2a55563cc8c4c4f81.png[/img]

If you preferred the original look of the game you can go back to it in the menu.

There have also been a few improvements to the game's balance.
